subject: general
question: What does it imply when people say to 'read between the lines'?

options.text: To read with an ability to infer the meaning
To skip initial and final lines in a paragraph

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Read between the lines"** refers to understanding the hidden or implied meaning in what is being said or written. (गूढ़ या छिपे हुए अर्थ को समझना)

 
 
• **Example: **When he said he was "fine," I could read between the lines and tell he was upset.
 
 
 
• **Correct Explanation:** To "read with an ability to infer the meaning" means comprehending not just the surface meaning of the text but also the implicit or underlying message. (अर्थ को समझने की क्षमता के साथ पढ़ना)
 
 
• **Example:** The author never explicitly criticized the government, but you could infer his disapproval by reading between the lines.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To read something fast** (तेज़ी से पढ़ना): Refers to the act of quickly going through written material without focusing on understanding deeper meanings.

 
 
• **Example:** She skimmed the document to read it fast before the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To skip initial and final lines in a paragraph** (अनुच्छेद की प्रारंभिक और अंतिम पंक्तियों को छोड़ना): Refers to ignoring certain parts of a passage, which often leads to missing critical information.
 
 
• **Example:** Skipping lines in the paragraph caused him to miss the most important details.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To avoid detailed information** (विस्तृत जानकारी से बचना): Refers to intentionally ignoring specifics or comprehensive content.
 
 
• **Example:** He avoided detailed information to save time during his research.
 
 

1a8:Tc9d,
The correct answer is **Option 3.**
